British couple exploring Saigon
Nov 2025 • Couples
Archetypal Vietnamese restaurant with wooden panels, fishpond and even with its own a flying dragon. Needless to say that the food tasted out-of-this-world. We were very well looked after — dishes appeared seamlessly on a table thanks to impeccable service of DUYEN our waitress. Highly recommend this amazing venue in D3.

So Many Traditional Dishes!
Jul 2025 • Friends
This is a large Indochine style restaurant with dark wood & even a large fish pool inside. The menu is enormous with dishes from the country’ different regions. I would have not know what or how to order. But my Viet friends ordered 10-12 dishes for the 3 of us. Each cost about $8-$9. From clams in a sauce to pork in baby pancakes, we had a great variety. 
Service was great, as they flowed the dishes thru the meal.
